ret.action_hint.archive: A copy goes to cold storage; records can be restored from the Archive tab.
ret.action_hint.audit: Audit entries can only be archived; they are never deleted.
ret.action_hint.export_then_delete: Everything removed is kept as one file of the run, then deleted.
ret.active_desc: Runs on its schedule. A paused policy keeps its history and runs only when started by hand.
ret.archive_intro: What retention moved to cold storage. An archived record can be restored under its own identity with its rows, links and files; log copies are kept as files with their hashes.
ret.class_hint.attachments: Files uploaded to records, except records under legal hold.
ret.class_hint.audit_logs: Copied to cold storage month by month, with proof of the hash chain. Entries are never deleted.
ret.class_hint.download_files: Finished custom downloads and their files.
ret.class_hint.records: Live records of the forms chosen.
ret.class_hint.recycle_bin: Deleted records still in the recycle bin.
ret.counts_text: {scanned} checked, {archived} archived, {deleted} deleted, {held} kept by legal hold
ret.cron_hint: Five fields: minute, hour, day, month, weekday. 30 2 * * * is every day at 2:30.
ret.days_hint: Counted from the date chosen next to it.
ret.delete_failed: The policy could not be deleted.
ret.delete_text: A policy that has never run can be deleted. One that has run is kept for its history: pause it instead.
ret.editor_subtitle: What this policy keeps, for how long, and what happens then.
ret.form_hint: Leave empty for every form (or every form of the application below).
ret.hold_failed: The hold could not be changed.
ret.hold_placed: Hold placed. Records under hold in this form: {count}
ret.holds_empty_text: Place a hold on a record, or on every record of a form that matches a condition.
ret.holds_intro: A record under legal hold cannot be deleted by anyone or anything — people, the recycle bin, retention or personal data requests — until the hold is lifted.
ret.lift_text: The records it covers can be deleted again, by people and by retention. Say why it is lifted.
ret.load_failed: Could not load this. Try again.
ret.logs_hint: The audit and error logs are split by month; the months ahead are prepared every night.
ret.name: Name
ret.pd_create_failed: The request could not be recorded.
ret.pd_done: The request has been carried out.
ret.pd_empty_text: When someone asks what is held about them, or asks to be forgotten, record the request here.
ret.pd_failed: The request could not be carried out.
ret.pd_found_hint: As of {when}. Approval searches again, so it acts on what exists then.
ret.pd_identifier_hint: A national id, a customer number or another value that identifies them.
ret.pd_intro: Find everything the system holds about a person, then export it, anonymize it or delete it. Nothing changes until the request is reviewed and approved with a reason.
ret.pd_reason_hint: At least ten characters. Kept as a justification that cannot be changed.
ret.pd_result: Done: {records} records changed, {held} kept by legal hold or still linked.
ret.pd_review_hint.anonymize: Approving cannot be undone. You will be asked for a two-factor code.
ret.pd_review_hint.delete: Approving cannot be undone. You will be asked for a two-factor code.
ret.pd_review_hint.export: Approving gathers what is found into one file.
ret.pd_subject_hint: Identify the person by at least one of these. Fields marked as personal data are searched for them.
ret.pd_type_hint.anonymize: After approval, personal-data fields are replaced with tokens and the history of those values becomes unreadable. Records stay.
ret.pd_type_hint.delete: After approval, the records about them are removed for good and their account is anonymized.
ret.pd_type_hint.export: After approval, everything found is gathered into one file to hand over.
ret.pd_type_hint.locate: Lists what is held; nothing changes.
ret.pd_unsearchable_text: {count} encrypted fields without a search index
ret.policies_empty_text: Without a policy, data is kept for as long as the system runs.
ret.policies_intro: Each policy keeps one kind of data for a number of days, then archives it to cold storage, exports and deletes it, or deletes it. Records under legal hold are always skipped.
ret.quotas_empty_text: Without a quota, files are limited only by the storage volume.
ret.quotas_hint: Past the warning threshold the quota shows a warning; at the hard limit new files are refused.
ret.reason_hint: Kept with the hold and in the audit log.
ret.restore_failed: The record could not be restored.
ret.restore_text: The record comes back to its form as it was archived, with its rows, links and files. Its archive copy is checked against the hash recorded when it was archived.
ret.run_failed: The policy could not be started.
ret.run_started: The policy is running. Its result appears under Recent runs.
ret.save_failed: Could not save. Check the highlighted settings.
ret.schedule_hint: Policies run on their own schedule; one run handles everything that is due.
ret.section.how: How long, and what happens then
ret.storage_intro: How the logs grow, the largest tables, storage quotas, and who uses the space. Alert rules in the Operations Center warn when a table or the volume crosses a threshold.
ret.subtitle: How long data is kept, what happens to it then, what may never be deleted, and requests from people about their own data.
ret.volume: The storage volume is {used}% full; {free} free.
